milestone: ATTR43: ordinary block property-hook Tick plans
status: Independently accepted bounded implementation; wider hook/header/lifetime and full-core obligations remain partial

production.scope: Undecorated ordinary by-value block hooks with clean headers compile after property defaults in source order. Each body delegates to the existing function visitor, preserving enclosing main adjacency and restoring its hook end line. A shared pure gate keeps the new property route disjoint from the legacy quiet route. No hook producer, linking, runtime consumer, task, state or schema changes.

authority.compiler: vendor/php-src/Zend/zend_compile.c: zend_compile_prop_decl processes the default before zend_compile_property_hooks; the latter loops the source list and calls zend_compile_func_decl_ex for separate hook op arrays. These operations add no main opcode. PROP_GROUP is unticked. Short bodies are rewritten to synthetic return/assignment statements and need a separate summary.
authority.existing_admission: Module382 admits the existing backed get-then-set pair and getter-only producer forms; module403 retains its setter/header restrictions. Completed source compiler facts remain authoritative. Reversed pairs and other producer dependencies were not widened.

author_source_and_control.scope: Uncalled backed get/set bodies declare frequencies 2 then 1. A balanced directive with a no-op preserves that final frequency and discriminates main adjacency before later Z/W callbacks. BAD never executes. A positive-frequency short getter retains Unsupported with an empty modeled prefix.

independent_source.scope: The first getter body Tick invokes callback 3, which reads sibling 9 and throws before the backing return 7. Catch C is followed by a second getter read returning 7 normally.

independent_reached.count_note: Reported conditions include helper bindings, not only independent assertions.
independent_reached.scope: At the genuine getter-body Tick the current hook target/source/receiver and pending caller read validate. Backing 7 and sibling 9 remain through callback 3 reading 9 then throwing. The second getter returns 7; exact counter 7/output, retained object/slots, heap/descriptors/Tick validity and full-state zero-budget/full-resume equality pass.

bridge: For property groups with no hooks, the hook-node fold is identity and the shared gate is true, preserving both ATTR42's constant visitor and its quiet exclusion pointwise. Legacy quiet short hooks still have a false block gate and retain the prior quiet route. No earlier source campaign was replayed.
